title: PIN zeroization: replace memset with wc_ForceZero / wp11_zero
description: src/cli/wp11_cli.c uses plain memset() to zero PIN buffers after use (lines 833, 943, 1060, 1142). Compiler can legally optimize away memset on a variable that is not subsequently read. wp11_zero (wrapping wc_ForceZero or explicit_bzero) already exists in the codebase. These PIN sites must use it.
